note: Glue submodule: a single event subscriber (DraggableViewsSyncExtend, service cms_content_sync_draggableviews.event_subscriber) that carries DraggableViews weights across sites via Content Sync push/pull events. No config/UI/Drush/permissions. Medium introspects the running site's container for that subscriber; hard is an enable-the-integration task (module toggling is safe - it has no dependents). No sync backend is needed for either.

evals.prompt: What does the cms_content_sync_draggableviews module do, and which contrib module does it require besides cms_content_sync?
evals.expected_output: It makes DraggableViews manual-ordering weights travel with entities during Content Sync push/pull (reading/writing the draggableviews_structure table), so drag ordering is preserved across syndicated sites. It requires the contrib draggableviews module plus cms_content_sync.

evals.prompt: How does cms_content_sync_draggableviews hook into Content Sync? Name the Content Sync events its subscriber listens to.
evals.expected_output: Via one event subscriber (DraggableViewsSyncExtend) subscribing to BeforeEntityTypeExport (add a draggableviews property), BeforeEntityPush (attach weight rows) and AfterEntityPull (write weights back).

evals.prompt: cms_content_sync_draggableviews adds an extra property to the Content Sync payload/entity-type export. What is that property named, and where does the weight data come from?
evals.expected_output: The property is named 'draggableviews' (DraggableViewsSyncExtend::PROPERTY_NAME); the weight data is read from and written to the draggableviews_structure database table.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, the cms_content_sync_draggableviews integration is active. Inspect the site's service container and give the machine id of the event subscriber service this module registers.
evals.expected_output: The service id is cms_content_sync_draggableviews.event_subscriber (class DraggableViewsSyncExtend). Confirm with drush ev '\Drupal::getContainer()->has("cms_content_sync_draggableviews.event_subscriber")'.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site uses Content Sync and the contrib draggableviews module. Enable the Content Sync integration that keeps DraggableViews ordering in sync across sites, so that drag-ordering weights are carried during push/pull.
evals.expected_output: The cms_content_sync_draggableviews module is enabled (e.g. drush en cms_content_sync_draggableviews -y), which registers the DraggableViewsSyncExtend event subscriber.
